name: Natsume Kei
source:
[url=/c33065]Naoya's[/url] good friend whom he has known ever since junior high.

[spoiler]After an eventful life, he enters the Natsume family. His personality gradually changes through encounters with Natsume Ai and a certain person. He still pursues Kusanagi Naoya, who broke his brush, as a goal. He believes in the genius of Kusanagi Naoya[/spoiler]
